findings.message: The `'..'` segment pre-check in openCodeRef repeats containment logic that resolveWithin already enforces (absolute-path refusal + as-written and post-realpath `within` checks). Harmless — it only refuses earlier and with a clearer log line — but it is a second copy of the escape rule that could drift; consider relying on resolveWithin alone and logging on its undefined result.
